$comment: Pure Terra. Chalk and chalkgill make it; nothing else comes close to a single-essence ratio.
Equal Ignis and Aqua — the sunleaf recipe, and the only one that wants a plant nothing else does.
Terra and Aer together — stone and feather, so it needs both the shaft and a hero.
Ignis and Umbra, no Terra. Barrow ash and emberstone; volatile by nature, so it bottles as a Bomb.
Pure Aqua. Mirefen pearl gets close on its own; the last few degrees want dewcap to pull the Aer out.
Pure Aer, and the one recipe a single ingredient nails outright — a skyreach feather is nothing else. The reward is that the feather is a hero's find, never a purchase.
Pure Umbra. Unbrewable until the shaft reaches nullstone, which is the point — the deep seam has to be worth the beams.
Aqua carrying shadow, two to one. Moonpetal is the clean route; pearl and gravecrown will do it the hard way.
Aer and Umbra with no stone in them. Nullstone and a feather, and nothing else comes close.
Fire and air, no earth — the pairing no mineral offers, which is what ashfern is for.
Even thirds of fire, water and earth. Every part is a staple, so the difficulty is all in the balance rather than the shopping.
Water, earth and air in thirds — the garden and the shaft together, with nothing from the barrow in it.
